summary: 6 features, one milestone H1: H1-01 main(argv, io) + lib/cli.mjs; H1-02 lib/helper.mjs + ask (91-resident-helper.sh); H1-02b call sites, lifecycle, helper-on/off logs identical (92-resident-helper-run.sh); H1-03 treekey cut; H1-04 the proof (last build); H1-05 review + docs. Lint clean.

discoveries.text: Three things the spec's request line (id, script, args, cwd) does not carry decide byte-for-byte identity. stdin: `inbox.mjs insert` (lib/record.sh, piped) and `notify.mjs trim` (lib/notify.sh) read fd 0, which inside the helper is the request pipe. Environment: lib/prompt.sh sets HARNESS_SUITE_LENGTH, HARNESS_SUITE_FAST_LENGTH and HARNESS_FIX on its render.mjs call, lib/record.sh sets HARNESS_CHECK_KEY_IGNORE on `treekey.mjs --pathspec`; treekey also reads HARNESS_CHECK_KEY_MAP, memlint MEMLINT_LINES, needs HARNESS_NOW and HOME. stderr: about 30 call sites in lib/*.sh redirect a served script's stderr (a file, run.log, /dev/null). H1-01 steps 4, H1-02 steps 3 and 6 and H1-02b step 1 cover them.

tests/checks/84-node-memo.sh and 81-partial-key.sh count node starts through a `node` shim (NODE_COUNT) in a shell that sourced lib/record.sh: once F asks the helper their counts fall. H1-02b sets HARNESS_HELPER=0 for their counting shells, the one kind of edit to an existing check the list allows (the spec's `every existing check passes unchanged` holds for every other file).

91 and 92 are the next free check-file numbers. The spec's one NN-resident-helper.sh is planned as two files, as 86/87 were: 91-resident-helper.sh (H1-02: `ask` in a shell that sources lib/record.sh) and 92-resident-helper-run.sh (H1-02b: the stub start and the two-lane run), each with its tier by the 30 s rule; `bash tests/run.sh resident-helper` runs both.

bash 5.2 here; its manual (Coprocesses) says a coproc's file descriptors are not available in subshells other than command and process substitutions: H1-02 checks `( ask … ) &` and `$( ask … )` on this bash rather than assuming either. None of the eleven served scripts has a module-level `let`/`var`; testcount.mjs reads process.argv at module level (its CLI tail) and has no main yet; render.mjs's main is not wrapped in process.exit.

harness status at init: RUNNING 1 (this run), QUEUED 0, runner going. H1-04 re-checks before each timed run (the brief: no other suite alive). Its wall is long by design: two solo full suites (last full run 957 s, timeout 2400 s each) and four runs of file 13, one at a time, in the background.

questions:
The spec plans H1-02 as one feature; the list splits it into H1-02 (lib/helper.mjs and `ask`, no call site moved) and H1-02b (the call sites, the lifecycle, the helper-on/off log diff), so H1-04 stays the proof and the last build feature, six features in all. It also takes three defaults the spec does not name: a served script reads environment from `io.env`, a stdin-fed call never reaches the helper, and a call site whose stderr is redirected goes through `ask` only where a check shows bytes and destination identical. All are recorded as *default*; say so in INBOX.md if you want otherwise.

# Progress — run `agent-harness-2026-11-05` (agent-harness)

What this file is: the run's journal, newest entry first, rendered by the harness from `entries.jsonl` for Michael's phone. Each entry is one session (init, coding, verify, review, retro) with its outcome, summary and questions.

The run: phase 2 of `docs/plans/2026-11-03-test-suite-redesign.md`, spec `docs/specs/2026-11-03-resident-helper.md`, one milestone H1 (6 features). A resident helper: one warm node process per driver and per lane (`lib/helper.mjs`, started lazily as a bash coproc) answers the `.mjs` questions that `ask` in `lib/record.sh` sends it, byte for byte what the spawned script printed, with a spawn whenever the helper is off (`HARNESS_HELPER=0`), absent, busy or broken. H1-01 gives the served scripts `main(argv, io)` and `lib/cli.mjs`; H1-02 builds the helper and `ask`; H1-02b moves the call sites and proves a stub run's logs identical with the helper on and off; H1-03 cuts `treekey.mjs`'s own cost; H1-04 is the proof (two solo suites, file 13 under strace, the table in `findings-and-research/2026-11-03-resident-helper.md`); H1-05 is the review and the docs. The spec's defaults are taken and marked *default* in `journal/decisions/2026-11-03-resident-helper.md`; nothing parks. No note text changes.

How to read the feature list (`feature_list.json`): array order is priority; `after` names what a feature waits on; `passes` flips when a session's fast tier is green, and the verifier re-runs every step on the full suite before H1 merges into `main`. Steer via `INBOX.md` on this branch: line 1 `status: pause|stop`, answers under `## Answers`.
